# Nunito

The unmodified variable font is distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1;
see `OFL.txt`. Copyright 2014 The Nunito Project Authors.

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/nunito

The plotting helper instantiates regular, semibold and bold weights into a
local ignored cache and embeds subset fonts in the vector PDF exports. The
SVG exports retain editable text; install Nunito to edit them with matching
typography. Mathematical glyphs use the plotting library's STIX math font.
